revoked.note: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/errorcodes.html: 401 and the [{message, errorCode}] shape; code and message from the StatusCode list at https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api/guide/sforce-api-calls-concepts-core-data-objects.html

body.message: You can’t perform the specified action because you don’t have sufficient permissions.

body.message: The request exceeded either the concurrent request limit or the request rate limit for your org.

rateLimit.note: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/errorcodes.html: request limits answer 403 REQUEST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, not 429; message from the StatusCode list. Salesforce documents no Retry-After; integration-mock adds one to every rate-limit answer
